name: Astrophysics Club
purpose: We're a student-led club that explores modern astrophysics and cosmology beyond what our regular science classes cover. At our meetings, we run student-led presentations and open discussions on topics like black hole physics, inflationary and pre-Big Bang cosmology, general relativity, and the black hole information paradox. Beyond our regular meetings, we bring in guest speakers, professors, graduate students, and researchers from universities and national labs, to share their work and give our members a real look at what modern astrophysics research looks like. We also connect members with outside opportunities like summer programs, competitions, and research experiences. Our goal is to build a community of curious students, make research-level ideas approachable, and give everyone a path into physics and astronomy beyond the classroom.
studentAdvisors: Abir Mehta, Dhruv Lagu, Saanvi Doshi
